Ana (CS): sharing a compact runbook draft for onboarding -> account health -> renewal signals. Trying to keep it short for SE handoff and quick ops reference. Feedback welcome. ⤵️
Ben (Solutions Eng): nice — can we add a 'soft_quota' and a client retry window? helps with bursty test traffic.
Ana (CS): good call. adding both. posting the 1-page checklist below so we can iterate.
Ana (CS): ```
1) 0-24h: Activation handshake — verify API key, environment, sample convo, basic perf smoke (p50 target ~<300ms)
2) 24-72h: Traffic ramp — enable edge batching, set cache_ttl=30s, streaming=true for large responses
3) Day 3-7: Health pulse — request success rate >99%, latency p95 <800ms, error spike <0.5%
4) Renewal signal logic: if usage growth flat for 14d AND NPS <=6 => renewal_risk=high; if sudden drop in session length -> re-engage SE
5) Escalation path: if errors >5% for 15m OR sustained p95 >1.5s -> open incident (ops + SE), attach last-20 transcripts
6) Feedback capture: short 1-min survey + scheduled 7-day follow-up + dump of recent conversation snippets (redact PII)
Fallback plan: route to a lower-capacity model (cost-tier) while preserving KV cache and using conservative batching to keep latency stable
Operational knobs: soft_quota_pct, client_retry_window_s, stream_chunk_ms, batch_max_tokens, cache_ttl_s
```
Maya (PM): love the brevity. Suggested client config snippet for docs so customers can copy/paste:
Maya (PM): ```json
{
  "client_retry_window_s": 60,
  "soft_quota_pct": 80,
  "stream_chunk_ms": 100,
  "batch_max_tokens": 1024,
  "cache_ttl_s": 30
}
```
Ben (Solutions Eng): will add a short paragraph in the onboarding email recommending those defaults + an example curl.
Ben (Solutions Eng): example curl: `curl -X POST https://api.redwood.example/v1/generate -H 'Authorization: Bearer <key>' -d @payload.json`
Luca (SRE): addendum on monitoring/alerts: instrument these metrics - `cs.requests.total`, `cs.requests.success_rate`, `cs.latency.p95`, `cs.errors.count`. Recommend alerts: success_rate <98% for 10m, p95 >1200ms for 10m, error rate >1% for 5m.
Luca (SRE): also capture a short run of logs on escalation: `kubectl logs -l app=runtime --since=15m` and attach to the PG.
Ana (CS): noted, will include SRE alert thresholds in the doc. Also adding a small checklist for SE handoff: quick perf report, last-50 messages sample (redacted), license & contact, renewal flags.
Ben (Solutions Eng): for streaming edge cases, call out keeping the client keepalive >90s for mobile SDKs to avoid reconnect churn.
Maya (PM): can we add a tiny template for the 1-min survey? 3 q's max.
Ana (CS): draft survey: 1) Was the integration straightforward? (Yes/No) 2) Did latency meet expectations? (1-5) 3) Anything blocking go-live? (free text)
deploy-bot: New doc uploaded to Confluence: https://confluence.redwood.example/display/CS/Handshake+Runbook+v1 (attached to the thread).
Ana (CS): please add any final language edits in Confluence. planning to push as 'CS Quick Runbook V1' tomorrow EOD. :thumbsup:
Ben (Solutions Eng): will add the example curl and a short troubleshooting flow (token errors, quota hits, model fallback).
Luca (SRE): quick note: redact tokens before sharing transcripts. we should include the automated scrub script snippet in the doc.
Ana (CS): will include scrub script and a one-line legal note about PII redaction. thanks all.
Maya (PM): great collaboration — looks ready for a light beta with 3 pilot accounts. I'll coordinate the pilot list.
Ana (CS): thanks — marking this thread as the source of truth for the initial runbook. follow-ups can be smaller threads referencing this ts.
